description: Header file defining structures, function prototypes, and macros for WiFi Easy Connect functionality, including event criteria, channel management, reconfiguration, and CSign instance handling.

classes.name: wifi_easy_connect_event_match_criteria_t
classes.description: Structure for matching criteria of WiFi Easy Connect events.

classes.name: wifi_easy_connect_best_enrollee_channels_t
classes.description: Structure representing available channels for the best enrollee.

classes.name: wifi_easy_connect_reconfig_t
classes.description: Structure for reconfiguration context and public key.

classes.name: wifi_easy_connect_csign_t
classes.description: Structure for CSign instance and sign key hash.

classes.name: wifi_easy_connect_t
classes.description: Main structure aggregating reconfigurations, CSign instances, and channels.

methods.name: get_easy_connect_best_enrollee_channels
methods.description: Retrieves the best enrollee channels for a given access point index.

methods.name: process_easy_connect_event_timeout
methods.description: Handles timeout events for WiFi Easy Connect.

methods.name: find_best_dpp_channel
methods.description: Finds the best DPP channel based on current context.

methods.name: is_matching_easy_connect_event
methods.description: Checks if an event matches certain criteria.

methods.name: wifi_dppStartReceivingTestFrame
methods.description: Starts reception of test frames for DPP.

methods.name: wifi_dppCreateReconfigContext
methods.description: Creates a reconfiguration context with given parameters.

methods.name: wifi_dppCreateCSignIntance
methods.description: Creates a CSign instance with specified key and hash.
